GOP Ad Buyer Misfires, Spends $25,000 in Wrong Portland

Allies of Maine Senator Susan Collins mistakenly spent $25,000 on an advertisement targeting her rival in Portland, Oregon, instead of Portland, Maine. The ad buyer confused the two cities, leading to the misdirected expenditure.
